svg.text: Unity convention: y up, z forward, x along the wings. Each turn is about the plane’s own axis
as it sits at rest; the arrows show the positive sense (right-hand rule about +y, +x, +z).
yaw = nose left or right; pitch = nose up or down; roll = wings tilt.
Aerospace uses x forward, z down: roll about x, pitch about y, yaw about z.
